fit_reason: Super Micro designs and sells liquid- and air-cooled AI servers with integrated GPUs, rackmount and blade systems, and offers rack-level design-to-deployment for full-rack and cluster AI and HPC builds, making it a server maker that assembles the whole system. Racks and servers is where accelerators, memory, networking and cooling come together, so the companies that assemble the whole system get the volume as accelerator purchases grow, and liquid-cooled racks add to demand. Servers and racks are essentially its entire business, and it is one of the largest dedicated AI server and rack-scale suppliers.

Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group sells rack, blade, tower and hyperscale servers along with storage and networking, and it builds rack-scale AI systems for cloud and enterprise buyers, making it a server maker. Every accelerator bought has to be deployed in a server and rack, and the companies that assemble the whole system get the volume as accelerator purchases and data center builds grow. Servers are now a central part of the business alongside PCs, and Dell is one of the largest AI server suppliers by revenue.

Celestica provides design, electronic manufacturing, mechanical integration and systems integration for hyperscalers, and sells servers, storage and data center switches, making it a contract manufacturer and server maker for cloud customers. Racks are where networking, cooling and memory come together, so the companies that assemble the whole system for hyperscalers get the volume as accelerator and data center buildouts grow. Its Connectivity and Cloud Solutions segment, built around hyperscaler servers and switches, is the larger and faster-growing part of the business, and it is a leading hyperscaler hardware assembler.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise sells ProLiant rack servers, BladeSystem and Synergy, and Cray and Apollo high-performance computing systems used for large AI and HPC clusters, making it a server maker of AI servers and rack-scale systems. Every accelerator bought has to be deployed in a server and rack, and companies that integrate the full system, including liquid-cooled racks where Cray is strong, get the volume. Servers are its largest segment alongside networking and storage, and it is one of the major enterprise and supercomputer server suppliers.

Sanmina provides manufacturing, assembly and test of complete systems, custom enclosures, backplanes and cable assemblies for OEMs including cloud computing customers, and it has added rack-scale AI server manufacturing through its acquisition of ZT Systems' manufacturing business, making it a contract manufacturer and enclosure maker. Companies that assemble servers and racks for others get the volume as accelerator purchases and data center builds grow. Cloud and AI infrastructure is a meaningful and growing part of a broad EMS business, and the ZT Systems deal makes it a significant rack-scale assembler for hyperscalers.

Jabil is an electronics manufacturing services provider that engineers metal and plastic enclosures, assembles systems and offers configure-to-order work for cloud, networking and data storage customers, making it a contract manufacturer. Contract manufacturers that assemble servers and racks for others share in the volume as more accelerators are deployed and data centers are built. Cloud and data center infrastructure is a meaningful and growing part of a diversified manufacturing business, and Jabil is one of the largest global EMS providers.

Flex offers systems assembly, enclosure fabrication and manufacturing for cloud computing and enterprise customers, along with server power supplies and data center power products, making it a contract manufacturer. Companies that assemble servers and racks for others get the volume as accelerator purchases and data center construction grow. Cloud and data center work is a meaningful part of a broad EMS business that also spans automotive, consumer and industrial markets, and Flex is one of the largest global contract manufacturers.

Lenovo's Infrastructure Solutions Group designs high-performance servers and handles motherboard design, system integration and full-rack assembly for server and storage systems, making it a server maker that assembles complete racks. Every accelerator has to be deployed in a server and rack, and the companies that assemble the whole system get the volume as AI buildouts grow. Servers are a meaningful but minority part of a business dominated by PCs and devices, and Lenovo is a top-tier global server supplier.

TD SYNNEX distributes servers and hyperscale infrastructure and, through its integration operations, provides design, integration, thermal testing, power-draw testing and burn-in for hyperscale systems, making it a contract manufacturer that builds racks for others. Companies that assemble servers and racks for hyperscalers get the volume as accelerator and data center buildouts grow. Hyperscale integration is a meaningful but smaller part of a large IT distribution business, and its Hyve unit is an established hyperscale server and rack builder.

NVIDIA designs the accelerated data center platforms that AI servers are built around, including rack-scale systems that combine its GPUs, CPUs and networking, which partners then manufacture, making it a designer of AI servers and rack-scale systems. Racks are where accelerators, networking, cooling and memory come together and every accelerator has to be deployed in one, so the company that defines the rack design shapes where the volume goes. Rack-scale system design is a meaningful part of a business centred on accelerators, and NVIDIA's reference racks are the standard for large AI deployments.

Vertiv makes integrated rack systems, modular designs and the power and thermal equipment that go into them, making it a rack and enclosure maker. Rack makers gain as more data centers are built and new rack designs such as liquid-cooled racks add to demand. Racks are a meaningful part of a business centred on data center power and cooling, and Vertiv is a leading supplier of data center infrastructure.

Penguin Solutions designs and delivers HPC and AI computing clusters for data centers and cloud environments through Penguin Computing, and supplies memory modules, making it a server maker and integrator of AI systems. Companies that integrate accelerators, memory, networking and cooling into working clusters get the volume as more accelerators are bought. Advanced computing is a meaningful share of a business that also includes memory and LED, and Penguin is a smaller but established AI cluster integrator.

nVent's Enclosures segment makes metal and non-metal enclosures, cabinets, sub-racks and the physical infrastructure that hosts and protects server and network equipment, sold under brands such as HOFFMAN and SCHROFF, making it a rack and enclosure maker. Rack and enclosure makers gain as more data centers are built and new rack designs, including liquid-cooled racks, add to demand. Enclosures are a large segment alongside electrical fastening and thermal management, and nVent is an established data center rack and enclosure supplier.

AMD supplies Instinct accelerators and EPYC server CPUs and, building on its ZT Systems design team, offers rack-scale AI system designs to hyperscalers, making it a designer of rack-scale systems. Racks are where accelerators come together with memory, networking and cooling, and the companies that define the whole system shape where the volume goes. Rack-scale design is a smaller part of a business centred on processors, and AMD is the main alternative rack-scale GPU platform to NVIDIA.

Cerebras builds its wafer-scale AI compute platform into complete rack-mountable systems for data centers, scaling to supercomputer clusters, making it a maker of AI servers and rack-scale systems around its own chip. Every accelerator has to be deployed in a server and rack, and companies that sell the whole system capture that volume. Complete systems are how Cerebras sells its accelerator, though the core of the business is the chip and its cloud service, and it is a niche but distinct AI system supplier.

Benchmark Electronics provides electronics manufacturing, subsystem and full system integration, assembly, configuration and testing for OEMs including advanced computing customers, making it a contract manufacturer. Contract manufacturers that assemble servers and systems for others share in the volume as more accelerators are deployed. Advanced computing is one of several markets alongside aerospace, medical and semiconductor equipment, and Benchmark is a mid-sized EMS provider with a modest share of server work.

Belden's Enterprise Solutions segment supplies racks, enclosures, interconnect panels and airflow management products for data centers, making it a rack and enclosure maker. Rack and enclosure makers gain as more data centers are built. Racks and enclosures are a modest part of a business centred on cabling, connectivity and industrial networking, and Belden is a secondary player in data center racks.

Cisco sells data center switching and, through its UCS line, servers including AI servers built with partner accelerators, making it a server maker. Every accelerator has to be deployed in a server and rack, so server makers gain as accelerator purchases grow. Servers are a small part of a business centred on networking, security and collaboration, and Cisco is a minor player in AI servers.

IBM's Infrastructure segment sells on-premises server and storage systems for critical and regulated workloads, making it a server maker. Server makers gain as more accelerators and data centers are deployed, though IBM's servers are built mainly for mainframe and enterprise workloads rather than rack-scale AI. Infrastructure is a meaningful but minority segment beside software and consulting, and IBM is a minor player in AI servers.
